title: MMGN Boilerplate - CLI & Starter Kit
description: Base template and CLI tool (`bunx mmgn@latest`) that automates project setup, allowing developers to choose between a full Dashboard or a Landing page, built to standardize architecture and conventions from the first commit.
architecture: Tool published on npm that resolves critical middleware and locale integrations, reducing initial setup friction and ensuring every project starts with a consistent, end-to-end typed architecture.
technical_details: I solved three non-obvious integration problems: the clash between Supabase middleware and next-intl, dynamic locale imports failing in Next.js, and a hook that ran conditionally. Prisma 7 is decoupled from the schema and Tailwind v4 is configured from CSS.

title: Personal Portfolio
description: Bilingual portfolio designed with a focus on technical versatility, combining an interactive frontend with an independent backend and a relational database.
architecture: Demonstration of fullstack capability through a hybrid stack (Next.js / FastAPI) built on PostgreSQL (Supabase), with automated email notifications and a clear separation between presentation and data layers.
technical_details: It includes a client brief that generates a PDF in memory and sends it by email with Resend, without storing files on the server. Data is validated with Pydantic, and every Supabase table has Row Level Security enabled.

title: ClassAid - Fullstack Platform for Teacher Management
description: Web application for school management, helping teachers organize information, evaluations, and academic progress tracking, with a focus on clear interface states (loading, empty, error, success).
architecture: Modular architecture designed to separate frontend and backend responsibilities, making it easier to iterate on screens without breaking the underlying business logic.
technical_details: Secure login with JWT tokens, a Node.js server with Express organized by modules, and data stored in MongoDB. Every route was tested in Postman before being connected to the frontend.

title: Web Around - Interactive Application
description: Interactive web application for real-time content editing, focused on data persistence per authenticated user.
architecture: Dynamic interface with real-time state handling, built with close attention to the different UI states (loading, error, authenticated/unauthenticated).
technical_details: REST API in Express with MongoDB, JWT-protected routes and form validation before sending data to the server. Vite as the bundler and reusable React components.
